title: QuantDeus Holding Startup Organization
mission: Создавать научно проверяемые продукты, исследования и инфраструктуру, которые снижают измеримый дефицит через ресурсный учёт, автоматизацию, открытый доступ, экологическое восстановление и технологии с земной и космической ценностью.

departments.name: Executive & Strategy
departments.mandate: Strategy, portfolio, operations and technical control.

departments.name: Science & R&D
departments.mandate: Evidence-first research across energy, governance, space and human capability.

departments.name: Growth, Marketing & Partnerships
departments.mandate: Brand, SEO, content, PR, community and strategic partnerships.

departments.name: Product & Engineering
departments.mandate: Discovery, requirements, architecture, security and software delivery.

departments.name: Quality & Reliability
departments.mandate: Automated QA, contract validation, repair loops and release confidence.

operating_model: Research maps needs, resources, constraints and evidence-backed opportunities.
Strategy converts signals from THRIVE I/II, The Venus Project, Реновация Земли and Рубежи науки into independently verifiable priorities.
Product & Engineering ships the smallest reversible prototype before scale.
QA blocks evidence, doctrine and contract drift and coordinates repairs.
Growth, Marketing & Partnerships turns verified outcomes into voluntary adoption, discoverability, collaboration and science communication.
